subject: Civil Engineering
title: The Interstate Highway System
description: A quick win: understand The Interstate Highway System.

hook.text: President Eisenhower signed the Interstate Highway Act in 1956 — the largest public works ever.

buildup.text: 46,876 miles of highway connect every major city. No traffic lights, no at-grade crossings.

discovery.text: Interchanges replaced intersections — cloverleafs, diamonds, and stacked ramps move traffic.

twist.text: Highways demolished neighborhoods in cities — urban freeways became controversial.

climax.text: The system moved America but also created car dependency — sprawl followed highways.

punchline.text: Roads connect, but they also reshape everything around them.

quiz.question: What controversial effect did urban interstate highways have on cities?
options: They made cities too quiet by removing street-level activity
They demolished neighborhoods and displaced communities
They caused cities to shrink in population dramatically
